trees.title: Bronze Skin
trees.identity: Take pain, make momentum. Build around impacts, Bronze equipment, or instinct.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: Bone, Steel, and Iron tags now count as a Barbarian tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: Bone Skin
nodes.effect: The first time you take damage each fight, gain 2 Harden.

nodes.name: Blood Price
nodes.effect: Mace connects heal {0.5}% of max HP per rank.

nodes.name: Wrath Unbound
nodes.effect: BONE WRATH also heals {1}% max HP per RAGE, per rank.

nodes.name: Scarred Hide
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Bludgeon
nodes.effect: ACTION: BLUDGEON (stuns).
nodes.payoff: Weapon kit expands; Bludgeon becomes an Impact hinge.

nodes.name: Concussive Crit
nodes.effect: Crit with a Mace: 35% chance to Stun for 1 turn.
nodes.payoff: Crits buy control, not only damage.

nodes.name: Venom Mace
nodes.effect: Mace hits against Poisoned enemies resolve one Poison tick and convert one stack into Acid.

nodes.name: Empty Fury
nodes.effect: +{25} STR for each empty action slot, per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Short strips hit harder; rewards strip discipline.

nodes.name: Iron Will
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Puberty
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{1} Strength per level.
nodes.payoff: Marks the Mace path; Strength grows with your level.

nodes.name: Blood Market
nodes.effect: Armor drops have a 50% chance to be a Barbarian material (Bone / Steel / Iron).
nodes.payoff: Loot bias toward your material/class tags.

nodes.name: Might
nodes.effect: ACTION: MIGHT — +1 STR for the dungeon.
nodes.payoff: Early dungeon power spike from the strip.

nodes.name: Tribal Kinship
nodes.effect: Each equipped Bone / Steel / Iron piece adds +{1} STR per rank.

nodes.name: Gut Instinct
nodes.effect: Every 5 effective INT adds +{1} STR to Mace actions, per rank.

nodes.name: Blood Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 STR adds +{1} to each RAGE / CRISIS / TRIUMPH mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Titan
nodes.effect: STR damage cap rises by {50}.

nodes.name: First Steel Age
nodes.effect: +{8}% damage per equipped Barbarian item, per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Material count becomes a build choice.

nodes.name: Scrap Prefer
nodes.effect: Battle Scarred / New / Masterwork pieces: +{10}% Barbarian damage per matching piece, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Steel Knuckle
nodes.effect: While Harden is active, Mace hits gain +{3}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Tempered Edge
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Living Alloy
nodes.effect: Harden and Fortify stacks count as Bronze items. A critical may consume one stack to repeat the current slot.

trees.title: Iron Discipline
trees.identity: Control the fight by converting defense and clean sequences into tempo.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Warrior

nodes.name: First Formation
nodes.effect: +{8}% speed per equipped Warrior item, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Warrior
nodes.effect: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% speed on your next action.

nodes.name: Metronome
nodes.effect: Combo slot 2 Sword hits gain +{4}% action speed per rank.

nodes.name: Cadence Keeper
nodes.effect: Alternating actions above and below base speed grants +{1} Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Flow State
nodes.effect: Three different actions connect without a miss: gain one reroll and exploding dice on the next action.

nodes.name: War Drum
nodes.effect: DRUM CUT: +{2}% speed per BEAT, per rank.

nodes.name: Drillmaster
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Phalanx
nodes.effect: While Fortify is active, Sword hits gain +{2}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.effect: Ending a combo without missing heals {8}% max HP per rank and converts leftover Focus into Fortify.

nodes.name: Gilded Guard
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Commission
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{15} Agility.
nodes.payoff: Marks the Sword path; baseline tempo before tag engines.

nodes.name: Muster Hall
nodes.effect: Armor drops have a 50% chance to be a Warrior material (Bronze / Gold / Mithril).

nodes.name: Cunning
nodes.effect: ACTION: CUNNING — +3 Agility for the dungeon.

nodes.name: Martial Kinship

nodes.name: Steady March
nodes.effect: Sword actions gain +{1} effective AGI per rank.

nodes.name: Drill Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 AGI adds +{1} to each BEAT / DRAG / STREAK mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Swift Strike
nodes.effect: Hit with a Sword: +{5} Agility for the turn, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Avenge
nodes.effect: ACTION: AVENGE (Finisher) — add Warrior tag to all actions.
nodes.payoff: Finisher refreshes the whole strip’s tag value.

nodes.name: Unbroken Stride
nodes.effect: +{5} Agility for each consecutive attack (resets OnTakeHit), per skill rank.

nodes.name: Parade Dress
nodes.effect: Worn / Like New / Heirloom pieces: +{10}% Warrior damage per matching piece, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Mithril Flow
nodes.effect: MITHRIL FLOW grants {0.34} Focus per STREAK, per rank.

nodes.name: Unbroken Ranks
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

trees.title: Shadowcraft
trees.identity: Build delayed payoffs from marks, status conversion, failure, and exact rolls.

nodes.name: Hairline

nodes.name: Shade
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Initiation
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{15} Technique.

nodes.name: Perfect Aim

nodes.name: Envenomed Edge
nodes.effect: Dagger hits convert one Poison stack into two Bleed; critical hits convert two.

nodes.name: Deep Cut
nodes.effect: Hits apply +{1} Bleed per rank (doubled on crit).

nodes.name: Toxin Pressure
nodes.effect: Hits against Poisoned enemies apply +{1} Bleed per rank.

nodes.name: Hemorrhage
nodes.effect: When Bleed ticks, apply Expose for one turn; if already Exposed, add Armor Break.

nodes.name: Dagger Mastery

nodes.name: Black Edge
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Spell Memory

nodes.name: Focus Lens

nodes.name: Loaded Odds

nodes.name: Refraction

nodes.name: Arcane Kinship

nodes.name: Weave Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 INT adds +{1} to each CHAIN / LENS / CONTACT mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Archmage
nodes.effect: INT's bonus to AMP and to your status durations gains +{100}%.
nodes.payoff: Your intellect hits harder and your spells linger.

nodes.name: Mana Bleed
nodes.effect: Spell/Wand connects restore {0.5}% of max HP per rank.

nodes.name: Sigil Burn
nodes.effect: Hits against Burning enemies gain +{3}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Thermal Shock
nodes.effect: Slow on Burning: {100}% chance to consume both and Stun; Burn on Slowed instead adds Vulnerability.

nodes.name: Slot Mind
nodes.effect: +{5} INT per current action slot (resets OnTakeHit), per skill rank.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.effect: RESONATE: +{2}% damage per CONTACT, per rank.

nodes.name: Clear Facet
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Grand Equation
nodes.effect: Once per combo, natural roll + strip slot = 21 retriggers the opener with current elemental statuses.

trees.title: Warbrute
trees.identity: Barbarian + Warrior: Body (STR + AGI) and Warbrute tags.

nodes.name: Warbrute
nodes.effect: Opens with 10 Barbarian and 10 Warrior points. Each hybrid rank costs half a point from each class.
nodes.payoff: Barbarian and Warrior become one path.

nodes.name: Body
nodes.effect: Body = STR + AGI. Body becomes your primary attribute.

nodes.name: Warbrute Material
nodes.effect: Barbarian and Warrior tags (materials included) count as Warbrute tags, and each tree's Barbarian / Warrior bonuses count the other class's tags and materials.

nodes.name: Body Blow
nodes.effect: ACTION: BODY BLOW - +{25}% damage on this hit for every 10 Body, per rank.

nodes.name: Warbrute Smash
nodes.effect: ACTION: WARBRUTE SMASH - +{25}% damage on this hit for every 10 Warbrute tags, per rank.

nodes.name: Body Surge
nodes.effect: +{1} Body for every connect (dice roll) this fight, per rank.
nodes.payoff: Body builds as the fight goes on.

nodes.name: Warbrute Momentum
nodes.effect: +{1} Warbrute tag for every connect (dice roll) this fight, per rank.
nodes.payoff: Warbrute tags build as the fight goes on.
